title: Devtool Chaperone: Compact SDK Boot Manifest (draft)
body:
Purpose
Provide a compact, opinionated manifest to shepherd small teams from repo -> sample app -> production route in under 30 minutes. This is intentionally lightweight: minimal commands, deterministic outputs, clear failure chaperones.

Scope
- Languages: JS (node), Python.
- Surfaces: core client, streaming example, telemetry hook, ephemeral auth (dev tokens).
- Not in scope: full infra templates for Dedicated/Private, complex multi-region routing.

Success criteria (observable)
- dev can run `chaperone init` and see a working echo app in 10 minutes.
- sample app has deterministic token/latency metrics emitted to local telemetry sink.
- one-page troubleshooting checklist resolves 80% of first-time errors.

Quick flows (minimal)
1) Install : toolchain installer (single script) -> adds `rwd` cli shim.
2) `rwd new sample echo --lang=python` -> creates tiny app with environment .env.example, minimal Dockerfile, run script.
3) `rwd run` -> spins local mock server, opens browser to /demo; streaming enabled.
4) `rwd smoke` -> runs tokenized prompt through hosted-sim and records latency+cost estimate to ./chaperone/telemetry.json.

Chaperone failure modes (guidance)
- auth: clear error message when token missing and link to token creation flow.
- network: local mock fallback when outbound blocked; show diff of expected vs actual response.
- schema mismatch: apply best-effort adapter and emit warning with suggested fix.

Telemetry contract (light)
- events: session.start, request.sent, request.completed, sample.error.
- fields: timestamp, sdk_version, language, route, seq_tokens, latency_ms, error_code (if any).
- stored in line-delimited JSON to ./chaperone/telemetry.log during dev.

Smoke-tests manifest (examples)
- connectivity: attempt 3 endpoints (hosted, dedicated-compat, local).
- streaming sanity: ensure first token arrives in <100ms locally.
- regression: sample prompt -> golden suffix match % > 85.

Rollout gating rules (for doc authors)
- ship initial chaperone CLI as experimental behind feature-flag.
- require two internal teams to hit 10+ runs with no major friction before promoting to beta.

Authoring primitives to include in docs
- one-page flow diagram (png) + 6-step checklist.
- single-file copy-paste example (python) that works with no deps beyond requests.
- troubleshooting card for the five most common errors.

Open questions / TODOs
- Should we include an OAuth helper for enterprises or keep only dev-token? (ask infra/compliance).
- Decision: ship node example first or parallel? (prod usage telemetry suggests node > python 2x).
- Need a tiny sample dataset for golden-regression tests (store as base64 blob).

Immediate next actions
- (Asha) prototype `rwd new` skeleton and push PR with tiny python sample. -> GH PR link above.
- (Liang) draft the one-page troubleshooting card and add to repo docs/.
- (Mateo) sketch the small flow diagram and export as PNG to `assets/`.

Notes to self
- keep commands idempotent; avoid heavy installers.
- surface costs estimates in the smoke run so developers get intuition about token economics early.
- collect first-run telemetry opt-in by default, store only on-device unless opted-in to upload.

Slack threads / references
- #devex-chaperone for real-time feedback.
- See ENG-805 for rollout gating details.

End.
